name: IRC_DA_PARTNER_NOTIF
description: This table contains the partner notification information for third party job site direct apply.

columns.name: DA_PARTNER_NOTIF_ID
columns.description: Primary key for the table. System generated.

columns.name: SUBMISSION_ID
columns.description: Job Application for which configured action is invoked in the candidate selection process. Foreign Key to IRC_SUBMISSIONS table.

columns.name: CURRENT_PHASE_ID
columns.description: Current Phase of Job Application for which this direct apply notification action is invoked. Foreign Key to IRC_PHASES_B table.

columns.name: CURRENT_STATE_ID
columns.description: Current State of Job Application for which this direct apply notification action is invoked. Foreign Key to IRC_STATES_B table.

columns.name: STEP_ACTION_USAGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key IRC_LC_ACTION_USAGES_B table. (Life cycle action context)

columns.name: PUBLIC_STATE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to IRC_STATES_B table. This refers to public job application status that can be shared with candidates.

columns.name: EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Occurrence time stamp when the direct apply notification action is invoked.

columns.name: PROCESSING_STATUS
columns.description: Processing Status of this direct apply notification.  Possible values are "Success", "Not Implemented", "Error", "N/A" etc.  Not look up values.

columns.name: TRY_COUNT
columns.description: This column stores the number of tries made to invoke the partner service.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
